pr_body:
Make sure Daikin ACs turn on on turn_on service

Set Daikin ACs HVAC_MODE to auto on turn_on, instead of empty dict.

Fix hanging identation in code.


## Breaking change
Not applicable.


## Proposed change
Currently turn_on service is ineffective for Daikin ACs as we send down an empty dict. With the change we set the HVAC_MODE to auto on turn on, so it will actually turn on the AC.

issue_context.title: Daikin Climate component is not acting on calling turn_on service.
issue_context.body:
## The problem
Calling the turn_on service on Daikin ACs do nothing, the onlz way to turn on these ACs is to set the HVAC mode. This impacts scripts and also the lovelace card where the turn on/off button is only valid for the turn off scenario.

## Environment

- Home Assistant Core release with the issue: All
- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known):  n/a
- Operating environment (OS/Container/Supervised/Core):  OS, Container, Supervised, Core
- Integration causing this issue: daikin
- Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/daikin/

## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml`

N/A

## Traceback/Error logs
No errors.

## Additional information
Issue is most likely in the code as we dont set anything:
```
async def async_turn_on(self):
    """Turn device on."""
    await self._api.device.set({})
```

The Daikin AC Type is:  daikin ftx35j2v1b

The issue is described here: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/37758

Setting the HVAC_MODE turns it on, sending turn_on service does nothing, even on the lovelace it is irresponsive.

Hm, have a look in the pydaikin code I linked to above, that will turn on if mode isn't `off`. The fix should be implemented there and this solution with setting motde to `auto` is not desirable.  (the unit and pydaikin knows the last state and we like to use that) .
